summary: This deluxe edition of Love Letter is the same beloved 16-card deduction game: players deduce and eliminate opponents by playing character cards with special powers, trying to be the last one holding (or holding the highest) card. Rounds are extremely short and rely heavily on bluffing and reading opponents.
praised: extremely quick and easy to teach
great portability and production in this edition
works well as a filler or icebreaker
criticised: can feel too light for gamer groups
player elimination within rounds, though rounds are short

interaction.kind: deduction, bluffing, and direct targeted elimination

scoring.why: winner is whoever accumulates enough favor tokens by surviving rounds, not by point totals
